oṃ namo gurave ||
alpavittānarā ye ca agnihotraṃ na kurvate | teṣāṃ prāṇāgnihotraṃ tu prasādaṃ kuru śūlabhṛt || 1 ||
śarīresmin katyagnayaḥ ko yajamānaḥ kā patnī ka ṛtvik | ko dhvayuḥ(?) | ko hotā | ka utgataḥ | ka upadraṣṭā | kaḥ pratiprasutā | kaḥ snātakaḥ | ka indraḥ | ka indrāgnī | kiṃ havirdhānaṃ | kimindhanaṃ | kaḥ kalaśaḥ | kā āpaḥ | korghaḥ | kimarghapātraṃ |
ko gandhaḥ | kiṃ puṣpam | ko dhūpaḥ | ko dīpaḥ | kā vediḥ | kā antarvediḥ | imidhmaṃ | ke paridhayaḥ | ko yūpā | kāraṇiḥ | kaśca samaḥ | kaḥ paśuḥ | ko homaḥ | kā rasanā | ka upayāmaḥ | kau sruk sruvau | kaḥ puroḍāśaḥ | kāni bhuvanāni | ke lokāḥ | kāni lokāntarāṇi | kiṃ juhoti | ka umādevatāḥ | prītā bhavaṃti | ityetatsṛṣṭi tatvaṃ tu bhagavanvaktu marhasi || ||
ati guhyataraṃ praśnaṃ yattvayā coditaṃ param | yanna kasya cidākhyātaṃ śṛṇu vakṣyāmi ṣaṇmukha ||
idaṃ rahasyaṃ paramaṃ na deyaṃ yasya kasya cit | parikṣya tu pradātatavyaṃ gurudevāgni pūjake ||
asmiñśarīre saptāgnayo bhavanti (*)(?) |
mukhe cāhavanīyognirdakṣiṇāgnirmanasthitaḥ | hṛdaye gārhapatyognirnābhyāsaupasadasmṛtaḥ | uttarognirbhruvormadhye ūrdhvāgnirdvādaśāntare | adhogniḥ pādayormadhye iti saptāgnayaḥ smṛtāḥ ||
eteṣāṃ tu śarīreṣu | puruṣo yajamānaḥ | prakṛtiḥ patnī | prāṇa ṛtvikā | prāṇodhva (*)(?)ḥ | apāno hotā | samāna udgātā | upānatā | draṣṭāvyānaḥ | pratiprasthātā | manaḥ snātakaḥ | ātmendraḥ | tṛṣṇendrāṇī | haviryānaṃ | mūlamantraḥ vahniḥ | sūryodayo homaḥ | mūrddhādroṇaḥ | kalaśaḥ śoṇitamāpaḥ |
keśādarbhāḥ brahmanāḍi rājyasthālikā puryaṣṭakaṃ grahāḥ | dantā arghaḥ | kapālamarghapātraṃ | paramānvivapaḥ(?) | paramātmā dīpaḥ | tanmantraḥ | puṣpam | vāto gandhaḥ | nāmāvediḥ | jihvāntarvediḥ | idhmamasthīni | antrāṇi paridhayaḥ | śotre ca samaḥ | ahaṅkāro dhūpaḥ | araṇi prāṇaśaktiḥ | buddhī bhruvau | upayāmaḥ | netre puroḍāśaḥ | cittaṃ paśuḥ | hastau sruk sruvau | indriyāṇyā hṛtayaḥ ||
anenaiva krameṇeti vidvānyadiju hoti vai ||
atha trayastriṃśaddeva koṭyastṛptā bhavanti | ya evaṃ vetti sa vedavit | sa ā hitāgniḥ sahathya kavyayoḥ samarthaḥ |
tasmāccharīreyeṣṭa sarve devatā yaṣṭā bhavanti | ataḥ paraṃ pravakṣyāmi ātmajñānaṃ śivoditam | jñānino yena mucyante ghorātsaṃsārasāgarāt ||
atra śarīre pādayorviṣṇurjaṅghayormarutaḥ | jānvoḥ pṛthvī ūrdhoḥ mittrāvaruṇau | kaṭyamindrāgni | gudevāyuḥ | liṅge bhadraḥ | asthi śīrṣe | kuvīraḥ | nāḍyā agniḥ | udare samudraḥ | antreṣu nāgāḥ | pārśvayoḥ hariḥ | pṛṣṭhe pitaraḥ | oṣṭhayoḥ dharmādharmau | nāsāgre tvaṣṭyā bāhvorvāyuḥ | grīvāyāṃ kālarātriḥ | hastayorindraḥ | hastatale krodhaḥ | aṅgulīṣu sarpāḥ | nakheṣu nakṣatrāṇi |
jihvāyāṃ śarasvatī | hanyoḥ(?) guruḥ | dakṣiṇa daṃṣṭrāsayamaḥ | vāmadaṃṣṭrāsu bṛhaspatiḥ | danteṣu marutaḥ | cakṣuṣoḥ candrādityau | śrotrayordiśaḥ | nāsāpuṭayoḥ dvāvaśvinau | aṅgapratyaṅgeva sarva hṛdaye brahmā | bhruvormadhye nārāyaṇaḥ | śirasi maheśvaraḥ | tasyoparyavyaktaḥ | sārāstisro romakoṭayaḥ tārakā bhavanti | atra nābhi prabhṛti śirontaṃ yāvatsaptalokāḥ kathitāḥ nāḍyāṃ bhūrlokaḥ | hṛdaye bhuvolokaḥ | kaṇṭhe svarlokaḥ | jaṭhare maholokaḥ | (*)(?) mūrdhni satyalokaḥ ||
ābhāsatālamuttalaṃ śrītālaṃ ca nabhastalam | nāḍyadhastāllatābhāsaṃ guhye bhūtālasaṃjñitam | kuḍprade (*)(?) śrītālaṃ gulphadeśerasātalam | pādayośca tathaivānyā pātālāssaptasaṃjñitāḥ ||
jambudvīpastu nidrā syād vyatiḥ kaumāryasaṃjñitāḥ | kuśaddīpaśca ciddhā tu krauñca dvīpastvahaṅkṛtiḥ ||
adānte siṃhaladvīpo manaḥ puṣkarasaṃjñitaḥ | buddhiḥ śākaladvīpaḥ syād dvīpāḥ saptatathoditāḥ ||
yathā hyasmiñśarīre tu saptanadyo vasanti ca | tathā caiva samāsīnaṃ śṛṇu vakṣyāmi ṣaṇmukha ||
gaṅgā ca śirasi proktā lalāṭe sindhureva ca | nāsāgre ca vitastātu kaṇṭhe syācchatarudrikā | hṛdaye yamunā proktā nāḍyāṃ caiva sarasvatī | airāvatī tu guhye syād vipāśā tadadhaḥ sthitā ||
sarvatīrtha mayaṃ hyetaccharīramadhunā śṛṇu | brahmadvāre brahmatīrthaṃ kedāraṃ śirasi sthitam ||
vārāṇasī lalāṭe tu hṛdaye puṣkaraṃ tathā | nāḍyāṃkanakhalaṃ caiva sarvatīrthāni cātmani ||
brahmāvartaṃ dakṣahaste tīrthānyetāni dehinaḥ | devatīrthaṃ pitṛtīrthaṃ vāyutīrthamataḥ param ||
somatīrthamagnitīrthaṃ śarīre tu sadāsthitam | satyatīrthaṃ dayātīrthaṃ tīrthamindriya nigrahaḥ ||
sarvabhūtadayātīrthaṃ nānyatīrthaṃ prakalpayet | tīrthānāmadhikaṃ tīrthaṃ yatra bhāvo hi nirmalaḥ ||
hṛaye merumāśritya candrādityau ca tiṣṭhataḥ | yā buddhissa ca ādityo yanmanaḥ sa ca candramāḥ ||
agniścaivatvahaṅkāro devārkarmendriyāṇi ca | sarvadeva mayo hyātmā sarvatīrthamayastathā ||
tasmāt sarvaprayatnena ātmasthamarcayet sadā | ātmastho yena hūyante nātmānaṃ nārcayanti ye ||
mūḍhāśayādurācārā anyadevārane ratāḥ | na te vidanti taṃ devaṃ sarva vyāpi namīśvaram ||
janmanā paśavaste hi iti satyaṃ ṣaḍānana | nārcayenmṛṅmayaṃ liṅgaṃ na śailaṃ na ca kāñcanam ||
arcayeddehajaṃ liṅgaṃ bhuktimukti phalapradam | svadehā yatanaṃ liṅgaṃ mano yatra svayaṃ prabhuḥ ||
hṛdpīṭhe karṇikāmadhye tatra liṅgaṃ prapūjayet | hṛtpīṭhe bhadrapīṭhoyaṃ sarvaratnavibhūṣitam ||
taṃ jñātvā caiva ṣaṇmāsāt sarvapāpakṣayo bhavet | amaṇḍale na bhoktavyaṃ na ca vai vāmapāṇinā ||
nagno mukta śikhaścaiva bhakṣayenna kadācana | viṣṇusomaśca sūryaśca hrī hutāśaḥ śacīpatiḥ ||
maṇḍalādupajīvanti tasmāt kurvīta maṇḍalam | asurāyātu dhānāśca krūrakarmaṇi rākṣasaḥ ||
balamannasya hiṃsanti maṇḍalena vivarjitam | maṇḍalāni prakurvanti caturaśraṃ trikoṇakam ||
kramadvayaṃ parimāṇaṃ vistīrṇaṃ munipuṅgava | nakhenaktanakhī bhutvā kāṣṭhena vyādhimicchati ||
aśmanā dhanahāniḥ syān mṛṇmayena kalirbhavet ||
ataḥ paraṃ pravakṣyāmi ātmajñānaṃ vidhānataḥ | yajjñātvā mucyate janturghorātsaṃsārasāgarāt ||
astreṇa sodhayetpātraṃ praṇaveṇāsanaṃ dadet | sakalaṃ haṃsa rūpaṃ ca śarīraṃ cintayedbudhaḥ ||
hṛdisthāne sthitaṃ kuṇḍaṃ praṇave naiva śodhayet | somasūryāgni kuṇḍe tu madhyasthaṃ jyotiruttamam ||
haṃsohaṃsākṣaro devo jīvādityastu suvrate | yatra jvālā kalāpeto bhāsayennābhi maṇḍalam ||
eṣā jvālā pradhānāsyājjihvāgraṃ pāti sarvadā | jaṭharāgnirvicintyosau pāvakaḥ parameśvaraḥ ||
anaṅgadhenu dugdhā ca dvādaśānte samāhitaḥ | prāṇādyā āhutīḥ pañca juhuyādyadi pāvake ||
pātre saṅgṛhya taccainaṃ recakaṃ naiva śodhayet | pūrakena vicintyai tatsomaṃ rūpaṃ ṣaḍānana ||
āpyāyakaḥ smṛta eṣā pūrṇenātha kuśena vā | prollikhellakṣaṇaṃ vipraḥ siddhākāmastu karmasu ||
ataḥ paraṃ pravakṣyāmi kalāḥ ṣoḍaśasaṃyutaḥ | sandhayodvaktramadhye tu svāhā nairāhutī bhavet ||
nābhi madhye smaret kuṇḍaṃ vaktra vahnendu mekhalā | tanmadhye saṃsthitaṃ jyotiśśivāgniḥ sarvabhakṣakaḥ ||
padmasaṃpuṭake līna jvālāmālā vapuḥ sthite | dvāsaptati sahasrāṇi nāḍayaḥ parikīrtitāḥ ||
annaḥ somaḥ sruvohastau dātā sūryo yajeddharim | brāhmīṃ samādhimāsthāya bhuṅke hyannaṃ caturvidham ||
prāṇopānaḥ samānaśca udāno vyāna eva ca | etyetā vāyavaḥ pañca śarīreṣu śarīriṇām ||
praṇamya hṛdayaṃ sthānamapānasya punargudam | samāno nābhi deśasthamudānaḥ kaṇṭhamāśritaḥ ||
pañcamastatra vijñeyo vyānaḥ sarvāṅga sandhiṣu | eteṣāṃ juhuyādannaṃ śarīraṃ mantrayed dvijam ||
etaistṛptaistu turvidhamāhāraṃ śuklaṃ pītaṃ jīrṇaṃ samānaṃ nayati | (**)(?) karaṇātmamānaḥ sthāpanādvāsamānaḥ | udāno nāma hikkāśabdaścharisphārakāsa (*)(?) sotkrānti codanaḥ | ūrdhaṃ nāmagamanādbodānaḥ(?) |
vyānonāmaprasāraṇā kuñcanollaṅghana plavanagamanaśamanorthāpana hasana gītanṛttavāditrābhilāṣa carita pravartako bhavati | vyāpanādvyāyaśchanādvāvyānaḥ | prāṇo hyaditya daivatyaḥ | (***)(?) somadaivatyaḥ samānasya tu parjanya udāno bhadra(?) daivataḥ | vyānaṃ(?) (*)(?) viṣṇu daivatya itye (*)(?) devatāḥ pṛthak ||
prāṇāgnihotra yatnena kuryāccaiva vidhānataḥ | sarvapāpavinirmukto brahmaloke mahīyate ||
anena vidhinā yacca bhuṅke hyannaṃ samāhitaḥ | tena tṛptena tṛpyante devatāḥ pitṛbhiḥ saha ||
hṛdisthā devatāssarvā hṛdi prāṇāḥ pratiṣṭhitāḥ | caturviṃśati tatvāni puruṣo hṛdaye paraḥ ||
nābherūrdhvamadhasthāśca kaṇṭhā dhastāt ṣaḍaṅgulam | hṛdayaṃ tadvijānīyādviśasyā yatanaṃ mahat ||
yognistṛpyati cāgnistu ekastiṣṭhati saptadhā | trailokyaṃ vyāpitaṃ tena yajante brahmavādinaḥ ||
viprādi śvapacāntānāṃ bhūtānāṃ ca hito nalaḥ | tasmaitā āhutīrdadyāt tṛptirbhavati cārdhayā ||
